gloss: final push; last spurt; sprint to the finish

definitions.gloss: final push; last spurt; burst of effort at the end
definitions.explanation: The concentrated effort made in the closing stage of a race, a project, or a period of study. Used both literally in sport and figuratively for any final stretch, usually with かける or に{入|はい}る.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ラストスパート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: This is where I make my final push.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ラストスパートだ。
examples.english: The exam is coming up, so this is the final push in my studying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{残|のこ}り→残り：01622_nokori⟧⟦{一|いっ}{周|しゅう}→一周：08917_isshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{先頭|せんとう}→先頭：04374_sentou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ラストスパート⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: With one lap left, the leading runner went into a final sprint.

notes:
A Japanese-made combination of ⟦ラスト→ラスト：30487_rasuto⟧ (last) and ⟦スパート→スパート：30603_supaato⟧ (spurt). The English word 'spurt' is not used this way on its own in Japanese, so ラストスパート is the fixed unit learners should remember.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ラストスパート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to make a final push
- ラストスパート⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the final sprint
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ラストスパート: the very last push (common though redundant)
- {売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ラストスパート: a final push on sales

USAGE:
Most often heard in sports commentary and in talk about deadlines, exam study, and sales targets. It implies effort deliberately saved for the end, not simply the end itself.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}み→追い込み：30518_oikomi⟧: the final drive — the native equivalent, also common for exam study
- ⟦{大詰|おおづ}め→大詰め：19935_oozume⟧: the final stage — describes the stage rather than the effort spent in it
